note.question: What determines congested network-based markets and their impact on competition, equilibrium charges and efficiency?
note.overview: The paper analyzes congested network-based markets and their impact on competition, equilibrium charges and efficiency. Several strategies are explored including price caps, mergers and investments in new technologies. The paper finds that congested networks served by collaborating (serial) and competing (parallel) firms may lead to excessive prices.
